topSignals.title: Quiet day across all monitored sections — Elcogen now 49 days quiet, Topsoe 74 days.
topSignals.text: Dedicated English- and German-language searches for both priority stacks, the Tier 2 dedicated rotation (Kyocera, Aisin) and sweep, the Tier 3 dedicated rotation (Fraunhofer IKTS/Kerafol, Plansee, Huatsing Power, Ningbo SOFCMAN, Chaozhou Three-Circle/CCTC, Watt Fuel Cell) and two further Tier 3 sweeps, and broad AI-datacenter/hyperscaler, regulation, competing-power, market/financials, research/IP, and scientific-paper checks all returned only recycled/already-logged background or out-of-window items. Two Project Jupiter articles surfaced by today's search (ABQ Journal's Oct 27 motion-to-dismiss denial, and a Nov 5 Bloomberg-sourced report that Yucca Growth Infrastructure waived its Nov 23 permit-decision deadline) were confirmed via direct fetch to pre-date the already-logged Nov 6 hearing vacatur — not new developments. No SOFC order, PPA, pilot, regulatory action, earnings move, or benchmark datapoint was found today. Elcogen News | Topsoe press releases

items.text: Elcogen (priority): No new news-archive item since Sept 21, 2026 (Metrosert cooperation), confirmed via English- and German-language searches today — 49 days quiet. Status unchanged: elcoStack E3000 G2 platform (75% FC electrical efficiency / 90% with heat recovery, 33 kWh/kg H2 SOEC — vendor claims) in volume production at the 360 MW/yr ELCO I Tallinn factory.

Topsoe (priority): No new solid-oxide-specific release since the Aug 27, 2026 H1 2026 results/SOEC pathway reset, confirmed via English- and German-language searches today — 74 days quiet; topsoe.com/press-releases remains dominated by PTX/ammonia/SAF/blue-hydrogen news, out of SOFC/SOEC scope.

Today's Tier 2 dedicated rotation — round 3 (Kyocera, Aisin): no new stack/cell-technology items for either; results were SEO-aggregator (enkiai.com) recaps of standing 2025-vintage SOFC-cogeneration background and routine autoparts-sector coverage, no new 2026 primary disclosure.

Tier 2 sweep — "Bloom Energy OR FuelCell Energy OR Ceres Power OR Sunfire OR SolydEra": no new item; results recycled standing enkiai.com SOFC-market recap pieces and the Bloom Energy/Oracle/AEP/Brookfield/Nebius deal cluster, all pre-dated.

Today's Tier 3 dedicated rotation — cycle 8, round 2 (Fraunhofer IKTS/Kerafol, Plansee, Huatsing Power, Ningbo SOFCMAN, Chaozhou Three-Circle/CCTC, Watt Fuel Cell): no new items for any of the six; results repeated standing IKTS/Plansee/KSOE Hannover Fair-era background, CCTC's materials-supplier history, Ningbo SOFCMAN's general China-SOFC-market coverage, Huatsing's standing background, and Watt Fuel Cell's residential-CHP/financing news (July 2026 equity raise, Dec 2025 first installation) — all pre-dated.

Tier 3 sweep — "Reverion OR Convion OR Hexis OR Doosan Fuel Cell OR SK ecoplant": no new item; results repeated the standing Doosan-Reverion $76.7-78M SOFC stack supply agreement and Reverion's $175M/€150M Series B background.

Tier 3 sweep — "OxEon Energy OR Nexceris OR Kawasaki Heavy Industries OR Miura OR Delta Electronics": no new item; results repeated the standing Delta Electronics/Ceres SOFC-licensing agreement background, with no new 2026 disclosure from any of the five.
Competitor roster: SOFC systems for data centers

Bloom Energy: Deployed/signed at multiple named sites — Oracle/Project Jupiter (NM, installation underway; Dec 7 air-permit hearing remains vacated, no new date set), AEP (1 GW), Brookfield EaaS, Nebius (328 MW/$2.6B, Vineland NJ), Equinix (>100 MW/19 sites), Aligned "Project Phoenix" (2 GW, PA), Hitachi (Japan), SK Eternix (Icheon/Paju, Korea, 28 MW, operational).

FuelCell Energy (incl. HyAxiom-branded products): Signed orders/PPAs — Fit Energy (up to 380 MW), Inuverse Korea (up to 100 MW), 75 MW Texas Capacity Reservation Agreement, SDCL (up to 450 MW). No named deployment live yet.

Doosan Fuel Cell/HyAxiom: Signed order — US AI data center supply contract (KRW 823.6B cumulative, mixed SOFC/PAFC); separately supplies SOFC stacks to Reverion. No named data-center site of its own yet.
Convion: Pipeline-only/pre-commercial under HD Hyundai ownership; no named data-center customer.
SK ecoplant: Pipeline-only (2023-vintage GDS Singapore SOFC deal); no new named data-center deployment.
Ceres Power's SOFC licensees (Doosan, Delta Electronics, Weichai): Licensing/pipeline-only; no named data-center deployment via Ceres licensing directly.
Reverion: Pipeline-only — Doosan-supplied SOFC stacks for rSOC power plants (Germany); no named data-center customer yet.
Petra Power: Pre-commercial, no named customer; first infrastructure deployment targeted 2028.
